gloss: absolutely; by no means; without exception

definitions.gloss: absolutely not; by no means (with a negative)
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative predicate to deny something flatly and with conviction. This is by far the more common pattern.

definitions.gloss: absolutely; without fail; come what may (with an affirmative)
definitions.explanation: Used with an affirmative predicate to declare firm resolve. Formal and emphatic, common in speeches and written declarations.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: I will absolutely not allow it.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{断|だん}じてない。
examples.english: There is absolutely no such fact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{断|だん}じて⟦そのような→そのような：30277_sonoyouna⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おりません→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: I have absolutely never made any such statement.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて⟦{実行|じっこう}する→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧。
examples.english: I will carry it out, no matter what.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて⟦やり{遂|と}げる→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧です。
examples.english: I am resolved to see it through to the end.

examples.japanese: {断|だん}じて⟦{行|おこな}えば→行う：01238_okonau⟧{鬼神|きしん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧、⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a saying that if you act with resolve, even demons will get out of your way.

notes:
The te-form of the classical ⟦{断|だん}ずる→断ずる：20377_danzuru⟧ (to decide, to judge), fossilized as an adverb. Formal and emphatic; in casual speech ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧ does the same work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断|だん}じて⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: will absolutely not tolerate
- {断|だん}じて⟦{認|みと}めない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: absolutely refuse to acknowledge
- {断|だん}じてない: absolutely not so
- {断|だん}じて⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to act with full resolve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: absolutely — everyday equivalent, works with both polarities
- ⟦{決|けっ}して→決して：01254_kesshite⟧: never — negative only, neutral in register and more common in writing
- ⟦{断固|だんこ}→断固：12714_danko⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: resolutely, firmly — about the manner of acting, usually affirmative
